name: decisions-base-render-class
context: Where the base render class lives. Authored into loom-weave in advance, or promoted up from a working weave.
chose: Promote to common, then comply. Work happens in loom-weave-godot. When a shape proves out there it is promoted into loom-weave as the common contract, and godot then conforms to what it promoted.
consequences: Nothing is authored into loom-weave in advance. Closes the OPEN item on the base render class. Recorded in the loom-weave README and in PROCESS.md.
